routes.name: Create Instructor Promotion Request

body.message: I want to publish courses for backend engineering students.

routes.notes: Student only. Creates a pending request and notifies admins. A student can have only one pending request.

routes.name: Get Promotion Requests
routes.notes: Authenticated users only. Admin sees all requests. Other users see only their own requests.

routes.name: Review Promotion Request

body.adminFeedback: Approved. You can now create courses.

routes.notes: Admin only. APPROVED promotes the requester to INSTRUCTOR and notifies the user. REJECTED records feedback and notifies the user.
